landing.title: Your road trip, set just right.
landing.lead: Set the pace and the detours. RoamGem plans the days, beds and gems.
landing.ctaNote: Free, ready in about a minute, no account needed.
landing.heroAlt: A mountain road winding through a green valley
landing.daysLead: An example route from Madrid to Brussels at about 350 km a day, a bed waiting at the end of each one.
landing.burgosAlt: The west front of Burgos Cathedral
landing.day1: Lerma and Covarrubias on the way
landing.checksTitle: AI invents places. RoamGem checks them.
landing.checksLead: Other planners write a nice list and hope it exists. Every gem on a RoamGem trip passed three checks before it reached your plan.
landing.check1Body: Each gem is a real place found on Google Maps, with its address and a link to it.
landing.check2Body: You see its rating and how many travellers gave it. Places with few or low ratings are left out.
landing.check3Body: Only places within about 20 km of the route you drive, so a detour stays a detour.
landing.challengeTitle: Snap the challenge, earn your points.
landing.challengeLead: Every gem has a photo challenge. Take it on the spot, post it, and climb the explorers board.
landing.challengeCardBody: Both towers of the city hall in one shot. 50 points.
landing.sanSebAlt: San Sebastián city hall among palm trees
landing.postedBody: Amboise castle, checked in on the spot. Others can like it.
landing.newGemBody: Pin it with a photo. When enough travellers visit, it turns official with your name on it.
